_note: Section manifest for SPEC-001 stacking sections. RATIFIED by Conti 2026-08-10 from Finn's notes/finesser/sections.draft.json (transcribed from the live pages). The plugin registers [brg_<id>] for EVERY entry, so a page never shows a literal shortcode; status:todo renders an invisible comment until its fragment lands at website/sections/<id>/embed.html. `stacks` documents per-page shortcode order (the harness reads it; the plugin ignores it). Slot defaults, when added, must be REAL production copy.
